commands..write: auth != null && auth.uid === $uid && newData.hasChildren(['action', 'timestamp']) && (newData.child('action').val() === 'start' || newData.child('action').val() === 'stop') && newData.child('timestamp').isString()

$signal..write: auth != null && auth.uid === $uid && data.exists() && data.child('status').val() === 'PENDING' && (newData.child('status').val() === 'CONFIRMED' || newData.child('status').val() === 'REJECTED')
